entry_stop.long_entry: first complete M1 ASK open at or after trigger knowledge time plus adverse entry slippage
entry_stop.short_entry: first complete M1 BID open at or after trigger knowledge time minus adverse entry slippage
entry_stop.target: frozen opposing H1 FVG near boundary

h1_fvg.aligned: bullish FVG only while H4 bias is bullish; bearish FVG only while H4 bias is bearish
h1_fvg.bearish: C1.low > C3.high; known at C3 close
h1_fvg.bullish: C1.high < C3.low; known at C3 close

h4_market_structure.bearish_break: first complete H4 close strictly below the latest already-confirmed H4 swing low
h4_market_structure.bias: direction of the most recent causal bullish/bearish break; equal knowledge times resolve lexicographically by event id
h4_market_structure.bullish_break: first complete H4 close strictly above the latest already-confirmed H4 swing high

rejection.long: first later complete H1 candle that intersects the bullish FVG and closes strictly above the FVG upper boundary
rejection.short: first later complete H1 candle that intersects the bearish FVG and closes strictly below the FVG lower boundary

target.long: nearest already-known bearish H1 FVG entirely above rejection close; choose smallest lower boundary then knowledge time/id
target.short: nearest already-known bullish H1 FVG entirely below rejection close; choose largest upper boundary then knowledge time/id

research_question: Does an H4 market-structure bias followed by an aligned H1 FVG and a same-timeframe H1 rejection after stinging the FVG produce a profitable continuation move toward the nearest already-known opposing H1 FVG on the OANDA NAS100_USD CFD proxy?

source_backed_semantics.candle_science: Price progresses through consolidation, expansion, consolidation; the third higher-timeframe candle can create an FVG that may be stung after that candle closes.
source_backed_semantics.pd_array_rejection: When an aligned PD Array is reached, same-timeframe rejection is evidence to get involved toward the next PD Array.
source_backed_semantics.rejection_examples: A bullish rejection may be a lower wick stinging the discount array or a strong up-candle; bearish mapping is treated symmetrically as an engine convention.
source_backed_semantics.stop: The stop belongs where price should not return; exact machine placement is an engine convention.
source_backed_semantics.target: PD Arrays not aligned with the active bias act as resistance and targets.
